Name: Rabbit as RO Lunatic Pet also replaces Rabbits Foot
Author: popobug
Description:
[code][/code][center][b][font=Georgia]Note: If you have another CP mod that also soft patches objectinformation.xnb, you might want to merge them if you want both of them to show up.[/font][/b]﻿


Hello! I made a rabbit mod that’s based off the Lunatic in Ragnarok Online. It also drops a rainbow carrot instead of a rabbit’s foot too! (no more feet!!)

You can toggle both the appearance of the rabbit and the rabbit’s foot replacer in the config file which appears after you let the game run once.

[b]REQUIRES SMAPI AND CONTENT PATCHER!!

[/b](No, you can't eat it.)[/center]

Manifest.Name: Rabbit as RO Lunatic Pet
Manifest.Description: Replaces rabbit as the Lunatic pet and the rabbit's foot into a rainbow carrot.
